notes: CHR-831. "+ New folder" pressed (button in `active` variant): `$new-folder-row` appears pinned at the top of the folder list with a focused input (accent border), Create (Enter) and Cancel (Esc). The folder is created inside the folder currently browsed (here ~/Workspace) — one level, the user can repeat it to nest. Name input is empty-validated: Create stays enabled only for a non-empty name. Project-name field and confirm button below are untouched until a folder is selected.
